name: Laniakea

verification.meaning: bathymetry appears sufficiently constrained for first-order modeling (NOT 'every reef feature is resolved')

caveats: MODELED ESTIMATE with known uncertainty -- not a safety device.
kr0 is a PINNED PRIOR (onset matches the surfer's observation), NOT an independent fit; reproducing the onset depth is prior calibration, not validation.
The '1.5 ft @ 10 s' onset is interpreted as buoy significant Hs (c_units=1.0); if it is Hawaiian scale the whole ladder shifts (~2x lever) -- unresolved.
Direction-shift s_dir=0 (prior): the peak is assumed on the fix line; bins far off the reference direction (12 deg) carry lower confidence until observations exist.
Modeled guidance radius ~35-80 m; the 30 ft target is display precision, not accuracy.

impact_zone_seaward_line is the SEAWARD boundary of the biggest sets' impact zone; danger is being SHOREWARD of it (danger_side). It is NOT a precise shoreward warning line -- that is deferred to the watch-app phase.
The reference marker sits on the 1.4 m inner flat and is NOT a takeoff position; modeled zones sit seaward of it for most conditions.
Tide is FIRST-ORDER at this reef (+-0.4 m on a 1-2.5 m flat moves breakpoints tens of meters); tide bins matter more here than at any outer reef.
Above ~10 ft buoy swell the outer reef outside Laniakea breaks first -- shadowed bins are flagged and position-unreliable.
W-WNW bins: waves break but close out / section (quality caveat, owner-observed).

hs_swell_ft.source: swell-band Hs integrated over swell_band_hz, buoy feet

dir_deg.source: energy-weighted a1/b1 over swell band; edges monotonic-in-wrapped-space (375=15, 405=45, 430=70)

disclaimer: Modeled estimate with known uncertainty (~35-80 m). Prior-pinned, uncalibrated. NOT a safety device.
